name: Roraima
summary: Diagonal bands of turquoise blue, white and green with a thin red band near the bottom and a gold star resting on it.
origin: Mário Barreto designed the flag, adopted by state law No. 133 on 14 June 1996.

symbols.name: Gold star
symbols.description: A star resting on the red band.
symbols.meaning: Wezen in Canis Major, which represents Roraima on the national flag.

facts: Mount Roraima, a famous tabletop mountain, marks the tripoint with Venezuela and Guyana.
Boa Vista is the only Brazilian state capital entirely north of the equator.
clues: Blue, white and green diagonals with a red line and a gold star.
Its red line is the equator.
